system.description:
A PC can snoop for information with a Presence or Instinct Roll. On a success, they can pick one of the below details to learn-or two if they critically succeed. On a failure, they learn nothing and potentially draw attention to themselves (see "Interlopers!").

  • An upcoming action the cult will take in a nearby settlement

  • The identity of an important cultist or thrall

  • The location of the cult's leader or main ritual site

What coded language does the cult use to disguise their actions? What is the mood among the cultists when speaking to one of their own?
